label: early copy step after input f/g/r/i, outputting r/s/n/f/h, long sequences
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (0.03% of steps), active only in the copy phase (never during original input or at <DEL>), and only when the fed-back input is a repeated token (in_first=0). Almost all activity (~98% of mass) is on steps whose input is f, g, r or i; it peaks at recall_idx 2-3 (t=10-12) and 81% of mass is on L=9, 14% on L=8, none for L<=5. Within that context it is further selective for the token being output (r, s, n, f, h strongest), but even with all these conditions precision is only ~14%, so the remaining selectivity depends on the wider sequence contents that simple variables do not capture. Strongest examples are input r/g/f/i at recall step 1-2 of 9-token sequences. It does not fire on other input letters, digits, or late copy steps.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
